devdoc.details: The token can be minted or burnt by whitelisted addresses only. Only the owner is allowed to enable/disable addresses.

params.owner: address The address which owns the funds.
params.spender: address The address which will spend the funds.

returns._0: A uint256 specifying the amount of tokens still available for the spender.

approve(address,uint256).details: Beware that changing an allowance with this method brings the risk that someone may use both the old and the new allowance by unfortunate transaction ordering. One possible solution to mitigate this race condition is to first reduce the spender's allowance to 0 and set the desired value afterwards: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/issues/20#issuecomment-263524729

params.spender: The address which will spend the funds.
params.value: The amount of tokens to be spent.

returns._0: Returns true in case of success.

params.addr: The address to query the balance of.

returns._0: An uint256 representing the amount owned by the passed address.

burn(address,uint256).details: This function throws if the sender is not a whitelisted minter. In this context, minters and burners have the same privileges.

params.amount: The number of tokens to issue/mint

params.newOwner: The owner of the smart contract.

grantBurner(address).details: This function can be called by the owner only.

grantMinter(address).details: This function can be called by the owner only.

mint(address,uint256).details: This function throws if the sender is not a whitelisted minter.

revokeBurner(address).details: This function can be called by the owner only.

revokeMinter(address).details: This function can be called by the owner only.

returns._0: Returns true in case of success.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: Note that while this function emits an Approval event, this is not required as per the specification, and other compliant implementations may not emit the event.

params.from: address The address which you want to send tokens from
params.to: address The address which you want to transfer to
params.value: uint256 the amount of tokens to be transferred

returns._0: Returns true in case of success.

transferOwnership(address).details: Throws if called by any account other than the owner.

params.addr: Specifies the address of the new owner.

devdoc.title: Represents a receipt token. The token is fully compliant with the ERC20 interface.

Approval(address,address,uint256).notice: This event is triggered when a given address is approved to spend a specific amount of tokens on behalf of the sender.

OnBurnerGranted(address).notice: This event is triggered whenever an address is added as a valid burner.

OnBurnerRevoked(address).notice: This event is triggered when a burner is revoked.

OnMaxSupplyChanged(uint256,uint256).notice: This event is triggered when the maximum limit for minting tokens is updated.

OnMinterGranted(address).notice: This event is triggered whenever an address is added as a valid minter.

OnMinterRevoked(address).notice: This event is triggered when a minter is revoked.

Transfer(address,address,uint256).notice: This event is triggered when a given amount of tokens is sent to an address.

allowance(address,address).notice: Function to check the amount of tokens that an owner allowed to a spender.

approve(address,uint256).notice: Approve the passed address to spend the specified amount of tokens on behalf of msg.sender.

balanceOf(address).notice: Gets the balance of the address specified.

burn(address,uint256).notice: Burns a given number of tokens from the address specified.

canMint(uint256).notice: Indicates if we can issue/mint the number of tokens specified.

changeMaxSupply(uint256).notice: Updates the maximum limit for minting tokens.

decimals().notice: Gets the decimals of the token.

grantBurner(address).notice: Grants the right to burn tokens to the address specified.

grantMinter(address).notice: Grants the right to issue new tokens to the address specified.

maxSupply().notice: The maximum circulating supply of tokens

mint(address,uint256).notice: Issues a given number of tokens to the address specified.

name().notice: Gets the name of the token.

revokeBurner(address).notice: Revokes the right to burn tokens from the address specified.

revokeMinter(address).notice: Revokes the right to issue new tokens from the address specified.

symbol().notice: Gets the symbol of the token.

totalSupply().notice: Gets the total supply of tokens

transfer(address,uint256).notice: Transfers a given amount tokens to the address specified.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).notice: Transfer tokens from one address to another.

transferOwnership(address).notice: Transfers ownership to the address specified.
